en.t: That is all I can say.

units.source_text: 发生了那件事以后，先生的性情就渐渐变了。

en.t: After that happened, Sensei's disposition gradually changed.

units.source_text: 他为什么死，我不知道，恐怕先生也不知道吧。

en.t: I do not know why he died, and perhaps Sensei does not know either.

units.source_text: 但是，一想到从那以后，先生就变了，也不能不让人这么猜测。”

en.t: But when I think that Sensei changed after that, I cannot help making that guess.

units.source_text: “杂司谷的墓，就是那个人的吧？”

en.t: The grave at Zoshigaya is that person's, isn't it?

units.source_text: 可是一个人仅仅因为失去一个好朋友，就会发生那么大的变化吗？

en.t: But can a person really change so much just from losing one close friend?

units.source_text: 这是我最想知道的，所以想请你帮我判断一下。”

en.t: That is what I most want to know, so I would like you to help me judge it.

units.source_text: 我的判断，倒是倾向于否定的。

en.t: My own judgment, if anything, leaned toward no.
